newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers up $2-$3 on crude, cargo gains.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers up $2-$3 on crude, cargo gains.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Thursday were quoted higher on crude gains and the recent climb in fuel oil cargo prices, traders said.
Majors were quoting 180-cst prices at $124 per tonne and 380 cst at $119. Independents were lower at $120-$121 for 180-cst and at $117-$118 for 380-cst supplies.
Prices on Wednesday were quoted at $119-$121 for 180-cst and at $113-$116 for 380-cst.
Traders said the market was thin and they expected demand to pick up later in the day.
MDO and gas oil prices were at $207-$215 and $220-$225.
